selector.rationale: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy best explains the sudden-onset chest pain, tachycardia, and systolic apical ballooning in the context of normal coronary arteries and the presence of an adrenal mass, which could be a trigger for the condition

rejected.label: Acute coronary syndrome
rejected.why: Normal coronary arteries on angiography contradict this diagnosis

rejected.label: Acute myocardial infarction
rejected.why: Normal coronary arteries and the pattern of cardiac enzyme elevation do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Adrenal carcinoma
rejected.why: While the adrenal mass is noted, the primary presentation and findings are more closely related to cardiac issues than adrenal pathology
